scope: Evidence-informed creative planning only; no production readiness, no observed retention or lift.

first_seconds.physical_action: Jay reaches to remove a glowing Gemini-labelled model cube from an illustrative workshop, while Asha stops him.
first_seconds.viewer_question: Did this new cloud partnership actually replace Gemini?
first_seconds.payoff_promise: See what the announcement changes for cloud developers, and what it does not.

instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: Jay mistakenly removes one cube; Asha returns it and reveals multiple choices.

instructional_moments.focal_object: Modular AI model cube and workflow board
instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: Asha plugs a model cube into a physical workflow track so the result becomes visible.
instructional_moments.takeaway: Cloud developers may get another model option.

instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: A glowing checklist flips through rollout, pricing and security controls.

instructional_moments.focal_object: Model cube and a crossed-out free-upgrade symbol
instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: Asha leaves the model in its cloud workspace, not inside a consumer smartphone.
instructional_moments.takeaway: Don't assume the consumer app changed.

dialogue_design.learner_question: So does this mean my Gemini phone app gets the tools instantly?
dialogue_design.presenter_response: No. This is a cloud marketplace announcement, not an automatic consumer upgrade.
dialogue_design.vocal_delivery: Conversational adult English voices, subtle contrast between surprise and patient explanation, no artificial hype.

episodes.originality_angle: Correct the common misconception that a new cloud collaboration replaces a competing consumer chatbot, using a tangible model-workshop analogy.
episodes.audience_question: Which everyday task would you like us to show with an AI tool next?

OpenAI Models on Google Cloud — Not What You Think
packaging.thumbnail_visual: Asha holding two distinct glowing model cubes; a bold illustrated cloud workshop, readable on a phone.

first_seconds.physical_action: Riya opens a holographic mouse brain cell dataset and thousands of small data tiles fan outward around her.
first_seconds.viewer_question: इतना बड़ा वैज्ञानिक डेटा सिर्फ 32 मिनट में कैसे पढ़ा गया?
first_seconds.payoff_promise: समझिए एआई टीम क्या करती है और वैज्ञानिकों की पुष्टि क्यों जरूरी है।

instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: The dataset expands into more tiles than Riya can inspect by hand.
instructional_moments.takeaway: This is a very large scientific analysis task.

instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: Kabir delegates separate research books to miniature 3D helper desks.
instructional_moments.takeaway: Divide big questions into smaller research jobs.

instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: Independent workstations send colored clues to one shared display.
A 'lead' card stays separate from a physical verification tray.
instructional_moments.takeaway: A fast hypothesis is not a medical cure.

instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: Characters close the hypothesis box and point at future lab verification.

dialogue_design.learner_question: तो क्या एआई ने वैज्ञानिकों के बिना इलाज खोज लिया?
dialogue_design.presenter_response: नहीं, उसने आगे परीक्षण करने लायक संकेत खोजने में मदद की।
dialogue_design.vocal_delivery: Natural Hindi speech, curious second voice, pauses after '32 मिनट' and 'इलाज नहीं'.

episodes.originality_angle: Explain the division of scientific work using a working 3D research library and avoid claiming mouse brain research establishes human treatments.
episodes.audience_question: आप अगली 3D कहानी में कौन-सा AI concept समझना चाहेंगे?

32 मिनट और लाखों Brain Cells: AI का असली काम
packaging.thumbnail_visual: Human researcher faces an enormous holographic mouse brain cell data field and a clearly illustrated stopwatch.

first_seconds.physical_action: A red alert lights a tiny city of symbolic software towers; Riya reaches for an emergency switch and Kabir stops her.
first_seconds.viewer_question: क्या एक लाल साइबर अलर्ट का मतलब इंटरनेट हैक हो गया?
first_seconds.payoff_promise: तीन डी कहानी में जानिए कैसे एआई सुराग से सुरक्षित अपडेट तक मदद करता है।

instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: Riya's reflex to sound a siren is stopped by Kabir pointing at an uncertain evidence label.
instructional_moments.takeaway: A warning is not yet proof.

instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: An agent assistant finds a marked unusual line inside one of many books.
instructional_moments.takeaway: AI speeds search, not final judgment.

instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: Omar transfers the suspicious code cube into a sealed safe research cube.
Riya physically moves unconfirmed evidence back to pending review.
Kabir hands the report to a defender, never broadcasting sensitive details.

instructional_moments.focal_object: Repair patch cube and test gate
instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: Omar replaces the damaged symbol and sends the repaired part through tests.
A released update travels only to a rack that has opted into the change.
instructional_moments.takeaway: The update must be installed correctly.

instructional_moments.focal_object: Fact check cards beside a social-media warning
instructional_moments.visual_cause_effect: Asha compares the misleading broad claim with official version-specific guidance.
Each character lays a block in order: find, verify, report, patch, update.

dialogue_design.learner_question: क्या हर लाल सिक्योरिटी अलर्ट पर घबराकर सब बंद करना चाहिए?
dialogue_design.presenter_response: नहीं, पहले खामी, प्रभावित संस्करण और ज़िम्मेदार प्रक्रिया की पुष्टि जरूरी है।
dialogue_design.vocal_delivery: Three to four differentiated Hindi character voices, professional delivery, gentle urgency at the first alarm then calm explanation.

episodes.originality_angle: Follow a fictional cyber-response team through an original ten-scene story. The audience can reconstruct the five safe process steps with physical objects, not see exploit instructions.
